disclaimer: Research snapshot. Verify all conditions at source before trading. Fees vary by region and promotion.

ftmo2.name: 2-Step
ftmo2.loss: Static overall; daily equity reset at midnight CE(S)T
notes: No funded profit target.
Evaluation has 4 trading days in each phase.
Daily equity limit recalculates using balance at midnight CE(S)T.

ftmo1.name: 1-Step
notes: 50% best-day consistency for accounts ordered on/after 12 Oct 2026; legacy differs.
No minimum trading days.
Maximum loss is trailing, not static.

instant.name: Instant
notes: No evaluation phase.
Best-day consistency must not exceed 30% of cumulative profit for rewards.
Trailing loss threshold does not reset after reward withdrawal.

holaPrime.name: 2-Step Prime
holaPrime.loss: Static maximum; daily loss based on previous day close
notes: $200K uses 4% daily and 8% overall loss limits.
Funded maximum combined risk per trade idea: 2% of initial equity.
Prime allows news and weekend trading subject to terms.
Biweekly: 14 days and 3 profitable days at least 0.5% each. Monthly: 30 days and 7 such days. On-demand: 40% consistency and 2% minimum reward.
Processing fee applies to payouts.

holaPro.name: 2-Step Pro
holaPro.loss: Static maximum; daily loss based on previous day close
notes: $200K uses 4% daily and 8% overall loss limits.
Funded combined risk per trade idea capped at 2%.
Funded news trading restricted 5 minutes before/after high-impact events.
Funded weekend holding prohibited.
Position-size limits apply to some sizes; verify official conditions.

topstep.name: Trading Combine
topstep.loss: End-of-day trailing MLL; threshold locks at starting balance
topstep.split: See Express Funded Account payout policies
notes: Trailing Maximum Loss Limit: $2,000 / $3,000 / $4,500.
55% Trading Combine consistency objective.
Max contracts: 5 / 10 / 15 minis or 50 / 100 / 150 micros.
Standard Path includes $149 Express Funded Account activation fee; no-activation path has higher monthly charge.
Express Funded Standard payouts require 5 winning days of $150 or more and positive net profit since prior payout.
No separately published Trading Combine daily loss limit; intraday MLL breach fails account.
